description: This file is a script used for platform-specific upgrade procedures for different router boards and devices within the OpenWrt firmware project. It defines functions to check image validity and perform upgrades based on the board name, with specific handling for various device models.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: A simple function that returns success, indicating the image is valid.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs device-specific upgrade procedures based on the board name, calling appropriate upgrade functions.
